protocol: Post-development adversarial audit. Cases and expected results written before first execution; code is frozen during this audit. Author has seen the implementation, so this is not blind or independent third-party validation. Supported and explicitly unsupported boundary cases are reported separately. Synthetic engine-level inputs; no production accuracy claim.
